==Bundles==
Radish Salad is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Radish Salad is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring|Silky Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt277a.png|24px]] It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
